title: Finch Circle Member Rate for Extra Fittings at Marlowe & Finch Alterations
content:
The extra fitting fee rate at Marlowe & Finch Alterations is set by the customer's tier in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program:

| Customer | Extra fitting fee rate |
|---|---|
| Active member at Finch Circle Platinum or above (a tier whose qualifying spend threshold is 2500.00 USD or more) | 50 percent |
| Active Finch Circle Gold member (tier threshold 1200.00 USD, below 2500.00 USD) | 75 percent |
| Anyone else | 100 percent |

**Records read.** The tier of the customer's Finch Circle membership and whether it is active.

## Tier edges

| Membership | Rate |
|---|---|
| Active, tier threshold 5000.00 USD or more | 50 percent |
| Active, tier threshold 2500.00 USD | 50 percent |
| Active, tier threshold 1200.00 USD | 75 percent |
| Active, tier threshold below 1200.00 USD | 100 percent |
| No active membership | 100 percent |

## Hypothetical illustration

On a fee basis of 40.00 USD, the rate gives 20.00 USD for an active Platinum member, 30.00 USD for an active Gold member and 40.00 USD for a customer with no active membership.
